advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Distinguish merge-base exit 1 (true no-common-ancestor) from other nonzero exits before logging DIVERGED, so a transient git error is retried rather than reported as divergence.
evidence: src/rebar/_store/sync.py:313: `if _ok(tracker, "rev-parse", "--verify", remote_ref) and not _ok(`

src/rebar/_store/sync.py:58: `def _ok(tracker: str, *args: str) -> bool:` returns `_git(...).returncode == 0` — False on any nonzero exit, conflating exit 1 (no merge base) with error exits (timeout, index lock, etc.)
`git merge-base` exits 1 only when there is genuinely no common ancestor; other nonzero codes are operational errors that are not divergence
advisory.finding: idle_sync classifies DIVERGED from `not _ok(tracker, "merge-base", "HEAD", remote_ref)`, but `_ok` returns False on ANY nonzero git exit (network/timeout/transient error), not only `git merge-base`'s exit code 1 ('no common ancestor'). A transient git failure is therefore misreported as a WARNING DIVERGED that tells the operator to run `rebar store fsck`.
advisory.suggested_fix: Capture the CompletedProcess and treat only returncode == 1 as diverged; on returncode > 1 (error) log at DEBUG and return a skip/retry outcome instead of 'diverged'.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Decide whether OptionalDependencyError from idle_sync's push should re-raise (like RemovedInputError) or be logged distinctly, rather than folded into the generic retry WARNING.
evidence: src/rebar/_store/push.py:520: `except OptionalDependencyError:` ... src/rebar/_store/push.py:524: `raise` with comment 'a deliberate fail-closed override of the best-effort contract ... let it escape'
src/rebar/_mcp_health.py:370: only `except RemovedInputError: raise`; src/rebar/_mcp_health.py:373: `except Exception:` logs 'idle tickets sync failed; retrying next tick' and continues
A misconfigured S3 remote that push_after_commit intends to surface loudly is swallowed into an indefinite WARNING retry loop on the idle path
dropped.finding: push_after_commit deliberately re-raises OptionalDependencyError as a fail-closed signal (a misconfigured S3 push remote should halt with an actionable install message), but run_idle_sync_loop catches it under the broad `except Exception` and demotes it to a 'retrying next tick' WARNING, so the fail-closed intent is lost and the misconfiguration is retried silently every 120 s forever. Only RemovedInputError is re-raised.
dropped.suggested_fix: Add `except OptionalDependencyError: raise` (or a dedicated distinct WARNING) alongside the RemovedInputError re-raise in run_idle_sync_loop so the fail-closed misconfiguration is not silently retried.
